stage: A: radar encoder into unchanged pretrained FCN linear2
contact_embedding: retrained_fcn_fixed_external hidden_mean, nonnegative 128-dimensional post-ReLU, XYZ/reference averaging
group_logits: logsumexp of original member logits, never mean weights
folds: 115200 to 460800 and reverse; entire contact/radar paired recording held out together
classification_scope: four original groups retained even in three-class evaluation; outer false predictions are not renormalized away
feature_loss: MSE between bag mean standardized radar h and source-contact bag mean standardized h
contrast: source bag prototype cosine, temperature 0.2, same-class positives only
KD: mean source-contact 10-class probabilities after logit division by T, sum groups; no deletion of wrong teacher predictions
reporting: external normal files, excluded from training
limitations: one source bag per class makes contrast essentially class-prototype supervision, not temporal alignment
linear2-input alignment alone can exploit head directions; geometry and embedding metrics needed
nonnegative outputs necessary but insufficient to establish true FCN feature manifold membership
outer/keep retain invalid approximately 0.884m ROI; ADC unavailable; never considered repaired
classifier supervision is permitted here and cannot be called unsupervised transfer
perfect embedding preservation necessarily preserves a teacher's wrong prediction
